catalyst.text: EUR/USD faces headwind from hawkish Warsh positioning and DXY strength while Germany's softer CPI could support euro. Conflicting signals.

week_ahead.text: Weak US employment data and Middle East uncertainty create diverging signals across major pairs including USD/JPY, EUR/USD , pulling the market between dollar strength and safe-haven appetite. August employment data from the United States could trigger a directional move next week , making nonfarm payrolls the week's critical catalyst for USD direction. USD/JPY's rebound from 155.22 resumed by breaking through 159.76 last week, with initial bias mildly on the upside , making the pair the primary barometer for risk sentiment shifts. Middle East escalation poses the biggest wildcard—any geopolitical flare-up would likely trigger safe-haven flows favoring the yen and driving risk-off moves despite moderately hawkish Fed signals.
